Dhanraj is remembered for expanding his kingdom and strengthening its borders against invading forces, particularly the Ghaznavids.

Another Dhanraj, a Maratha prince, ruled the princely state of Jaisalmer from 1582 to 1620 AD. Dhanraj also undertook various architectural projects, including the construction of the Jaisalmer Fort and several temples in Jaisalmer and nearby areas.
